data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-b-r', meaning 'great' or 'large'. It is a name of admiration and respect, evoking images of vastness and magnitude. The name Kabira carries the meaning “Great, Large” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kabira usually hope their child will grow to embody great, large and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kabira total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
